commands: Executor runs the reviewed experiment externally with the returned lease token and deadline; no CLI execution occurs.
python3 -m rsi finish Q14 --actor executor --token TOKEN --manifest /absolute/finish.json
python3 -m rsi reject Q14 --actor independent_validator --reason "Observed regression"
python3 -m rsi observe legacy-001 --actor supervisor --note "Research evidence only; legacy non-preregistered run" reports/2026-10-25-execution-sweep.json
python3 -m rsi abort Q14 --actor executor --token TOKEN --terminal-proof /absolute/terminal.json --reason "Verified process failure or changed artifact"
budget_note: 25 USD is an example admission budget, not extra spending authorization. Supervisor chooses within user-authorized scope.

finish_manifest.process_handle: actual docker/session handle plus terminal result

integration_required: Current moe_local.py legacy reports lack new strict provenance and structured correctness fields. Extend harness or reviewed executor adapter before promotion; never fabricate assertions after the fact.
Freeze isolated baseline transitive imports and fixtures; a class source string alone is insufficient.
Use canonical GPU coordinator for every executor; existing direct run_h200.sh does not acquire RSI lease automatically.
A measured failure can be recorded and rejected; validation errors do not silently alter experiment state.

terminal_proof.process_handle: actual process/container identity and authoritative exit result

v1_to_v2: python3 -m rsi --ledger results/rsi/ledger-v2.json init --budget-usd 25; then re-propose/re-review with canonical shared GPU coordinator. Existing v1 stays untouched.
